material_findings.title: xTech|Kinetic Reach demonstrates another lifecycle-active versus submissions-closed mismatch
material_findings.summary: USA.gov currently lists xTech|Kinetic Reach as active through November 30 with $1.5M in cash prizes and up to $12.7M in follow-on opportunities, but the Army primary competition page explicitly says the submission window is closed and shows Phase 1 as June 5-June 30, 2026. material_findings.recommended_action: Use this as another deterministic actionable-freshness fixture: preserve lifecycle status separately from submission status, and do not present xTech|Kinetic Reach as open for new applications.
